g.text: logical_product(A,B): repeat tile A according to B
Purpose: logical_product builds a larger layout by repeating smaller tile A according to layout B.
Overall: build candidate repeats of tile A, use layout B to select repeats, then return (tile A, selected_repeats).
B may select any tile_idx below cosize(B), so first build cosize(B) candidate repeats of A over size(A)*cosize(B) flattened slots.
Then B selects size(B) tile_idx entries from repeat_layout; the product is (tile A, selected repeats of A).
that we want to repeat to cover
then those tiles map to starts.
Examples expanded: coordinate = (element inside tile, selected repeat); offset = element + tile start
